summary: Iteration 27: Payment Behavior FY Filtering & Feature Gating Tests - Backend: 15/15 PASSED. Frontend: All features verified. Fixed 1 BUG: Duplicate 'Insider Result' nav item in sidebar.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate 'Insider Result' nav item appears in sidebar. The nav shows 12 items instead of 11 because 'Insider Result' is added twice: once from FEATURE_NAV_MAP (when 'insider' is in user.features) and once from hardcoded push at line 231.
ui_bugs.fix: Remove the hardcoded push at line 231: `items.push({ id: 'insider', label: 'Insider Result', icon: Lightbulb });` since 'insider' is now in ALL_FEATURES and gets mapped via FEATURE_NAV_MAP
